body:
### Found by

reading `src-tauri/core/src/fees.rs`

### Where

`src-tauri/core/src/fees.rs`, `quote`

### Observation

The base price and the price per kilogram of each zone are literals in a `match` inside `quote` (`(350, 50)`, `(590, 120)`, `(1490, 400)`). Nothing names them, so a price cannot be read or reused without calling `quote`.

Done when: each zone's two prices come from one named place, and the four tests pass unchanged.

### Size

S

### Waits on the owner

Nothing.
title: The zone prices are bare numbers inside quote()
